text.p: -- ING Barings said it has maintained its buy rating but lowered its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Brazilian pulp and paper firm Aracruz Celulose SA.
-- Analyst Paulo Vasconcellos said he lowered his 1997 estimate to $1.20 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) from $1.45 per ADR to reflect weaker than expected first-quarter results.
-- He also reduced his 1998 forecast to $2.91 per ADR from $3.29 "due to lower price assumptions."
-- "We continue to believe that positive developments following CVRD's privatization and price improvements could lead to a rally in the stock price," Vasconcellos said.
-- He set a December 1997 price target of $23 per ADR, representing an upside potential of 21.8 percent.
-- Aracruz's preferred B share was up 0.5 percent at 2.01 reais at 1623 local/1523 EDT on the Sao Paulo bolsa while its ADR was off seven-eighths at 18-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
